# vastdata_compute_cluster_namespaces (Data Source)

Kubernetes namespaces in a compute cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vastdata_compute_cluster_namespaces" "tf_test_cluster_namespaces" {
  compute_cluster_name = "tf-test-cluster"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `compute_cluster_id` (Number) Compute cluster ID. Provide this or compute_cluster_name.
- `compute_cluster_name` (String) Compute cluster name. Used to look up the cluster ID when compute_cluster_id is not set.

### Read-Only

- `namespaces` (Attributes List) Kubernetes namespaces in the compute cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--namespaces))

<a id="nestedatt--namespaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `namespaces`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Namespace creation timestamp.
- `name` (String) Namespace name.
- `status` (String) Namespace status (Active, Terminating, etc.).
